spec.kitLine: Full Charge -> Gain Pierce for 6 sec
spec.assertion: A gainPierce effect with durationSec 6 exists and hasPierce is not set. Fails under the nearest-wrong static hasPierce:true flag (tags every hit from t=0, including the ~1s before the first full charge and any lapse of the 6s window). Removal is asserted one-sided on totals (<=) because pierceDamagePct may be engine-inert in v1.

Effect with atkPct 290 and flavor 'distributed' in skill1; removing it drops milk total damage and drops rider-damage events by >=1 and <=40 over 180s. Fails under the nearest-wrong ungated per-full-charge entry (~125 charges at 0.69 shots/s = ~125 procs) and under the line being unmodeled (touched===0 / delta===0).

A consumeAmmo effect with fraction 1 exists in skill1 and its removal changes the reload-event count. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'weapon-state line is defensive, skip it' (taxonomy 6: ammo/reload lines gate shot count and are damage).

buffApply stat atkPct value 118.7 targeted at milk only; authored durationSec 40. Shrinking to 10 sec strictly reduces total damage, so the test fails under the nearest-wrong 10-sec (burst-window) duration and under an ally/team-scoped target.

it.skip - a fixed-at clamp is a distinct primitive from reloadSpeedPct (additive) and durationShots is explicitly documented as NOT covering fixed-at-x-for-N-rounds lines. No discriminating assertion is expressible.

it.skip (flagged) - the kit gives no duration for the STATE, only for its 40 sec ATK buff, so the re-entry cadence between forced-reload-length (~5-6s, ~30 procs/fight) and buff-length (40s, ~4 procs/fight) is a per-unit estimate. Bounded rather than pinned: the 290% test only asserts 1 <= procs <= 40.

buffApply stat pierceDamagePct value 64.7 targeted at milk only, authored with NO durationSec. Fails under the nearest-wrong short refreshing window and under mis-encoding the scoped Pierce stat as generic attackDamagePct.

The 447.7% effect carries flavor 'distributed' plus a 2 sec cadence (dot intervalSec 2 or interval trigger sec 2) bounded by the 10 sec window (dot durationSec 10 or a burstCast trigger); its removal costs damage but drops at most ~6 rider hits per full burst. Fails under the nearest-wrong ungated whole-fight interval (~90 ticks) and under a single 447.7% one-shot per burst.

Self-targeted burstCast buff, atkPct 220, durationSec 10, at most one apply per rotation. Stretching the window to 40 sec must STRICTLY increase total damage - RED if the driver authored 40 sec (borrowed from the Embarrassment buff) or keyed it to fullBurstEnter (which would over-fire on rotations milk does not cast).

Self-targeted burstCast buff, pierceDamagePct 117.64, durationSec 10; removal of both Pierce buffs cannot raise milk damage. One-sided on totals by design (pierceDamagePct is documented as possibly inert in v1), strict on structure.

it.skip - no primitive suppresses a self kit-state for a window (targetStatus is enemy-only; mode / resourceGate cannot be flipped by a burst cast for 10 sec). In-sim the burst window can still re-enter Embarrassment; the error direction is a small over-credit of 290% procs + ATK refreshes.

fixtures: controlComp('milk-blooming-bunny', false) for every run - liter (B1) + crown (B2) + milk (B3). helm is deliberately excluded: helm is a SECOND Burst III, which makes it ambiguous how many rotations milk actually casts on and would break every burst-window count assertion (procs per burst, applies per rotation, the 10 sec window). As the sole B3 milk casts every rotation, so fullBurstStart count == milk burst count; liter + crown are mandatory because a lone B3 makes ZERO full bursts. 10 hoisted 180s runs: base, plus counterfactuals removing the burst ATK 220 / extending it to 40s / removing the Embarrassment ATK 118.7 / shrinking it to 10s / removing the 290% rider / removing the 447.7% rider / removing consumeAmmo / removing both pierceDamagePct buffs / removing gainPierce. All counterfactuals are built with withPatchedOverride and assert their own patch matched >0 effects, so an unmodeled kit line fails RED instead of passing vacuously.
gaps: skill1 e3 'reload speed fixed at a 50% reduction for 1 reload' - stat CLAMP primitive; reloadSpeedPct is an additive modifier and durationShots is explicitly documented as not covering fixed-at lines (engine-modeling-gaps 1b).

burst 'Gains Immunity to Embarrassment for 10 sec' - no primitive suppresses a self kit-state for a timed window (targetStatus is enemy-only; mode/resourceGate are not burst-flippable). In-sim Embarrassment can re-enter during the burst window.

skill1-b Embarrassment STATE duration / re-entry cadence - MEASUREMENT-GATED. The kit gates entry on 'not in the Embarrassment state' but never states how long the state lasts; plausible readings span ~5-6s (forced reload at half speed) to 40s (the ATK buff). Asserted only as a bound (1..40 procs per 180s), not pinned.
